settings.heroSubtitle: Where light becomes language. We create images that transcend documentation — photographs that breathe, emote, and endure.
settings.aboutQuote: "Photography is not about the camera. It is about the photographer — their patience, their eye, their willingness to wait for the world to become itself."
aboutParagraphs: Éclat Media was founded on a simple belief: that every subject — human or otherwise — has an inner light.
We shape calm, editorial imagery with a documentary instinct, creating photographs that feel luxurious without losing honesty.
From intimate portraits to large celebrations and commercial campaigns, every project is guided by detail, atmosphere, and story.
settings.bookingSubtitle: Tell us about your project. We'll be in touch within 24 hours.
settings.footerTagline:
Visual storytelling for those who
believe images should endure.

London, UK — Available Worldwide

services.name: Wedding Photography
services.description: Elegant coverage for intimate ceremonies and destination celebrations, crafted with a cinematic eye.

services.name: Portrait Sessions
services.description: Modern portraiture for individuals, couples, and families with gentle direction and timeless styling.

services.name: Brand Storytelling
services.description: Refined visual assets for founders, products, and campaigns that need atmosphere as much as clarity.

services.name: Fine Art & Exhibition
services.description: Thoughtful imagery for artists, galleries, and curated exhibitions that deserves a refined, immersive presentation.

services.name: Lifestyle & Family
services.description: Warm, natural sessions that preserve connection, personality, and everyday beauty with polished direction.

services.name: Video & Motion
services.description: Cinematic motion coverage for campaigns, events, and stories that need atmosphere, movement, and strong visual rhythm.

process.name: Discovery
process.description: We start with a conversation about your vision, references, schedule, and the feeling you want the work to carry.

process.name: Planning
process.description: Locations, styling notes, timelines, and shot priorities are shaped into a clear production plan.

process.name: Capture
process.description: On the day, we direct lightly and observe carefully so the final images feel polished and alive.

process.name: Delivery
process.description: Your gallery is edited with consistency and care, then delivered in a format ready for print and digital use.
